title: Why are billionaires building bunkers?
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
Why do you think extremely wealthy people are interested in private bunkers?
Does preparing for extreme disasters show good planning or excessive fear?
If society faced a major crisis, would it be ethical for the richest people to protect only themselves?
What kind of disaster would make you seriously consider creating an emergency shelter?
Would you spend money on a bunker if you were a billionaire, or use that money differently?
